identity_evidence.verdict: `Rabbit` is COINED. The cartridge's class name is daMip_c. Coined names are allowed under PIPELINE.md's disclosure rule; this field is the disclosure. KEEP the `Rabbit` spelling in the source anyway -- see keep_the_coined_spelling below -- and never present it as ROM-proven.
identity_evidence.rom_string: extracted/overlays/overlay_0085.bin file offset 0x0709c -> address 0x021300bc, bytes 37 64 61 4d 69 70 5f 63 00 = "7daMip_c\0". That is the Itanium length-prefixed _ZTS form: length 7, then the seven characters d a M i p _ c. config/arm9/overlays/ov085/symbols.txt names that address `_ZTS7daMip_c`.
identity_evidence.negative_search: Scanned 2,179 images: extracted/arm9.bin, extracted/arm9_dec.bin, extracted/arm7.bin, all 103 extracted/overlays/*.bin, and all 2,073 files under extracted/dsd/files. Byte patterns and results -- b'Rabbit' (case-sensitive): 0 hits. b'rabbit' with re.IGNORECASE (so Rabbit/RABBIT/rabbit all match): 0 hits. b'6Rabbit\x00' (the length-prefixed _ZTS form a class named Rabbit would emit): 0 hits. b'9RabbitKey\x00': 0 hits. So the word `rabbit` does not occur in this cartridge in ANY case, in code, in data or in the filesystem. By contrast b'daMip_c' (case-sensitive): exactly 1 hit, overlay_0085.bin 0x0709d, inside the b'7daMip_c\x00' hit at 0x0709c. b'mip' case-folded: 38 hits, of which the load-bearing ones are the asset paths in overlay_0000.bin -- 'data/enemy/mip/mip.bmd' (0x006df), 'mip_run.bca' (0x018c3), 'mip_wait.bca' (0x021d7), 'mip_hold.bca' (0x02637), 'mip_run_ed.bca' (0x03d17) -- and the profile-name strings 'MIP' and 'OBJ_MIP_KEY' in arm9_dec.bin. `mip` is the cartridge's own word for this actor; `rabbit` is ours.
identity_evidence.profile_name_is_rom_attested: The arm9 profile-name table at 0x02090e80 (an array of char* into arm9 rodata; found by locating the string 'MIP' at 0x0208f678 and the single pointer to it at 0x0209116c) has index (0x0209116c-0x02090e80)/4 = 187 = 0xbb. g_profile_MIP at 0x021300d4 carries 0x005300bb at +0x04, low half 0x00bb = 187. Neighbouring indices read KINOPIO(185), PEACH_PRINCESS(186), MIP(187), RACE_NOKO(188) -- the same order ov085 lays its classes out in. Cross-check: 'OBJ_MIP_KEY' is at table index 229 = 0xe5 and g_profile_OBJ_MIP_KEY+0x04 low half is 0x00e5. So `g_profile_MIP` is a ROM-attested name, not a coined one.

identity_evidence.symbols_txt_asymmetry: config/arm9/overlays/ov085/symbols.txt aliases the VTABLE under both spellings at one address (`_ZTV6Rabbit` and `_ZTV7daMip_c`, both addr:0x021300f8) but names _ZTS and _ZTI under the daMip_c spelling ONLY. A TU compiled as `struct Rabbit` therefore emits _ZTS6Rabbit and _ZTI6Rabbit, neither of which has a home in the cartridge. That is survivable on the queue's declared text-only route (RTTI is externalized/deadstripped) and FATAL on an intact-object route. Do not attempt intact-object under the coined spelling. Independently, `_ZTV6Rabbit`/`_ZTV7daMip_c` is a multi-name data object at one address, which blocks the intact-object route on its own.
